text: 科创50ETF华夏（588000）、创业板ETF易方达（159915）、沪深300ETF华泰柏瑞（510300）成交额均突破100亿元（目前分别为151亿、129亿、100亿），此三只ETF连续三个交易日均突破百亿成交。此外，昨日科创50ETF华夏（588000）净申购76.29亿份（净申购资金137.01亿元）创单日净申购历史最高记录。
text_en: The trading volumes for STAR 50 ETF ChinaAMC (588000), ChiNext ETF E Fund (159915), and CSI 300 ETF Huatai-PineBridge (510300) all exceeded 10 billion yuan (currently 15.1 billion, 12.9 billion, and 10 billion respectively). These three ETFs have all exceeded 10 billion yuan in trading volume for three consecutive trading days. Additionally, yesterday STAR 50 ETF ChinaAMC (588000) had net subscriptions of 7.629 billion units (net subscription funds of 13.701 billion yuan), setting a single-day net subscription record.
